{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures each patient appears only once, with their latest (highest sample_seq) test
# We do this BEFORE filtering by arm and severity to avoid missing data

# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending) to prepare for deduplication
df_sorted = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])

# Drop duplicates on patient_id, keeping the first (i.e., highest sample_seq) row
df_dedup = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Now filter for control arm and moderate severity
control_moderate_dedup = df_dedup[(df_dedup['arm'] == 'control') & (df_dedup['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check the number of such patients
n_control_moderate = len(control_moderate_dedup)
print(f'Number of control-arm, moderate-severity patients after deduplication: {n_control_moderate}')

# Check if any of them have responded (1)
responded_count = control_moderate_dedup['responded'].sum()
print(f'Number of responders among control-arm, moderate-severity patients: {responded_count}')

# Compute the fraction
fraction_responded = responded_count / n_control_moderate

# Return the result
{'n_control_moderate': n_control_moderate, 'responded_count': responded_count, 'fraction_responded': fraction_responded}"}
